summary: This lecture from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) covers Islamic rulings on fasting practices and etiquette in worship. Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses permissible and impermissible days for voluntary fasting, including details about fasting on specific weekdays (Mondays and Thursdays), avoiding fasting on Saturdays or Fridays alone, and prohibitions against fasting during Eid and the days of Tashreek. The lecture also covers the important concept of moon-sighting for determining the Islamic calendar months, emphasizing that fasting begins when the community collectively acknowledges the new month, not merely upon individual sighting. The second portion transitions into a unique chapter about Islamic naming conventions, proper speech, and language etiquette according to the Sunnah of the Prophet.
